basis: Follow-up to preserved latched-cue FAIL. Under the user-specified fixed-speed-per-map condition, a note's estimated remaining travel time should not increase as it approaches the receptor. Pixel quantization can create upward estimate bumps.
engineering_assumption: Latch cue activation until the note disappears; while active, clamp each new countdown to min(previous_countdown, current_valid_countdown), holding the last countdown on invalid/no-motion frames.
claim_boundary: Frozen-policy timing transfer over fixed pre-map speeds only; no claim for mid-map speed changes or complete charts.
pass: All learning-on traces emit exactly one lane-0 DOWN within +/-73.5ms of note contact, followed by UP exactly 10ms later; repeated traces match exactly; weights unchanged; untrained seed 907 is silent at 1x.
